answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 6746 Country: FJ Title: Meaning of the names: "Ifraz-ud-Dean" and "Nezmal Ali" and whether these names are lawful. Question: Meaning of the names: "Ifraz-ud-Dean" and "Nezmal Ali" and whether these names are lawful. Answer ID: 6746 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 772/772=M/1429) ?Ifraz-ud-Deen? ( افراض الدین ) means: to establish religion, implement religion, while ?Nizam Ali? means: the Order of Ali. It is better to change both the names a little: (1) Mufrizuddin [ مفرض الدین ] (2) Abdul Ali [ عبد العلی ]. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
